summary: Explore, discover & enjoy my city life adventure in pretend play Tizi town games
description:
Enter this huge city & pretend to play a role in the cafeteria, supermarket, airport, hospital, police station & much more. Explore everything that Tizi City has to offer in this app! There are no rules in the game, you can explore your imagination & show your creativity. 

Tizi City has tons of fun stuff to offer:

Airport 
Have you always wanted to be an airport manager ✈️ and work in an airport? Then this app will take you on the perfect adventure! Explore every corner of the airport and get ready to travel for your vacation! Show off your creativity through storytelling and role-play. ☁️

Cafeteria 
Be the #1 chef 👩‍🍳 and serve delicious food from the menu to your valued diners. Create unique recipes of your choice and display your talents! Tap and move everything on the screen to discover magical surprises 🎁!

Dance School 
Do you love to dance? Gather around in the dance school & start practicing with your friends. Polish your moves every day & show off your skills. 
 
Fire Station 
In this fire station, you will find a bright red fire truck packed with all the important equipment! You get fire extinguishers, megaphones, first aid box, fire hose and so much more in this fire station. It's JUST like a real one! 😃

Hospital 
It's time to become a doctor and cure patients in your own hospital! This isn't an ordinary hospital game, it's something totally unique! Play doctor games in this pretend hospital and have tons of fun.🏥

Indoor & Outdoor Gym 
Get fit by working out each day. There is a football ground & basket court where you can show some great moves. Explore each corner in this gym now!🏋️

Features of the app are: 
🏢 15 cool & beautiful rooms to explore.
🏢 Play with fun new characters.
🏢 Touch, drag and explore every object and see what happens!
🏢 Kids friendly content without violence or scary treatments
🏢 Made for kids of ages 6-8, but everyone will enjoy playing this game.

Are you ready to explore each and every room in this Tizi City? Get started now by downloading My Tizi City - Town Life Games!
